brief:
Palestinian and international human rights organizations are calling on the United States to remove sanctions imposed on three Palestinian rights institutions: al-Haq Foundation, Al-Mezan Center for Human Rights, and the Palestinian Center for Human Rights, Shehab Wire reported. The three groups operate as independent monitors focused on documenting alleged abuses and advocating for legal accountability across Palestinian territories.

The demand comes after an extended period under the U.S. sanctions regime. The move reflects mounting pressure from civil society actors who argue the restrictions hamper legitimate human rights work and investigation into violations. All three organizations have maintained that sanctions undermine their capacity to conduct fact-finding missions, publish reports, and engage in international advocacy on behalf of affected populations.
